summary.key_theme: Cybercab 發布會表現不如預期，引發市場對 Tesla AI 轉型策略與監管風險的強烈質疑。

bullish.title: Cybercabs are a game changer, says Mike Khouw. Here's how he's trading Tesla
bullish.reason: 分析師認為 Cybercab 具備改變產業遊戲規則的潛力，為選擇權交易者提供看漲機會。

bullish.title: Cathie Wood Has Stuck With Tesla Through Repeated Missed Robotaxi Deadlines. Here's Why She's Still Buying.
bullish.reason: 知名投資人 Cathie Wood 持續加碼，顯示其對 Tesla 長期 AI 與自動駕駛願景的堅定信心。

bullish.title: Tesla Plus SpaceX Could Become a ‘Must-Have’ Investment, Ross Gerber Says
bullish.reason: 投資人 Ross Gerber 看好 Tesla 與 SpaceX 在 AI 領域的協同效應，認為兩者結合具備長期投資價值。

bearish.title: Cybercab a Cyberflop? Tesla’s Robotaxi Launch Delivers Tiny Fleet, Big Investigation.
bearish.reason: Cybercab 發布會僅推出 45 輛車，且隨即面臨 NHTSA 監管調查，嚴重打擊市場對自動駕駛擴張的信心。

bearish.title: Tesla's stock drops 6% as Cybercab update 'underwhelms' Wall Street
bearish.reason: 發布會內容未能滿足華爾街預期，導致股價單日下跌 6 %，反映投資人對缺乏具體定價與量產細節的不滿。

bearish.title: Goldman Sachs Delivers Stark Message on Tesla Stock — Tesla's Cybercab Faces a Major Test
bearish.reason: 高盛指出 AI 執行力比車輛成本更重要，暗示 Tesla 目前的技術落地能力面臨嚴峻考驗。

bearish.title: Tesla Says This Time Is Different. Wall Street Is Split on Whether to Believe It
bearish.reason: 儘管營收成長 25 %，但財報獲利錯失預期近 40 %，且現金消耗嚴重，引發市場對基本面與 AI 願景脫節的擔憂。

bearish.title: Tesla Wants to Be Seen as an AI Company
bearish.reason: 管理層積極將 Tesla 定位為 AI 公司，但財報數據顯示核心汽車業務仍面臨壓力，市場對此轉型持懷疑態度。

neutral.title: Is Tesla Stock Under $360 a Share an Obvious Buy in September?
neutral.reason: 探討股價估值與買入時機，屬於市場常見的技術性分析，未提供新的基本面催化劑。

neutral.title: Elon Musk Owns 28% of Tesla, a Stake Worth Nearly $350 Billion. Here's Why His Ownership Level Matters for Shareholders.
neutral.reason: 分析 Elon Musk 的持股結構對股東的影響，屬於長期治理層面的討論，對短期股價影響有限。

neutral.title: Tokenized Nvidia and Tesla Are Becoming Trending Crypto Trades, CoinMarketCap Says
neutral.reason: 提及代幣化股票的交易趨勢，反映散戶投機行為，與公司實際營運無直接關聯。
